notes: Northbound I-405 closed in Bellevue, SE 8th to NE 4th, 11 PM Friday to 4 AM Monday.
Mostly sunny; 20% chance of rain after 11 PM.

blocks.play: Downtown hotel core to SEA from about 4:45, or an Eastside reservation if one is booked. Airport departures build from 6 AM.
After a SEA drop-off, take a curb ReMatch within 10 minutes or leave right away.
Bellevue hotel checkouts to SEA; Friday is a big fly-home day.
Short Pike/Pine rides as bars fill. Optional.
Downtown let-outs: Benaroya and 5th Avenue about 10 PM, Paramount about 10:20 to 10:50. Wait a few blocks off the venue curbs.
Stay in the core between bar hops. Showbox SoDo lets out about 10:30 to 11:15.
Bar close wave about 1:30 to 2:30 AM in Capitol Hill, Belltown and Pioneer Square.
blocks.zone: Bar close: Capitol Hill, Belltown, Pioneer Square

plan.headline: Friday: an early downtown-to-SEA morning, or a night with four mid-size downtown let-outs from about 10 to 11:15 PM, then bar close.
